units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 44:3">Targ. O. Gen. XLIV, 3</cite> (Y. <cite ref="N00267"><he>נְהִיר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 18:5">Targ. Job XVIII, 5</cite>; a. fr.—

Taan. 10ᵃ נְהוּר ענני וכ׳ when the clouds are bright, their waters are little. Pesik. Ekha, p. 123ᵃ יִנְהוֹר דינא וכ׳ let justice shine before thee like this lamp; Yalk. Is. 258 יִנְהַר דיני וכ׳ let my case shine &c.; Sabb. 116ᵇ נְהוֹר נהורך וכ׳ let thy light (wisdom) shine (prob. to be read: ינהור); a. fr.—Part. pass. נְהִיר; f. נְהִירָא; pl. נְהִירִין; נְהִירָן

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>אולפני מה נ׳ באפי</he> how my learning shines on my face (makes me look well); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 964:15">Yalk. Prov. 964</cite> <he>נרי באפוי</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:1:7">Y. Sabb. VIII, beg. 11ᵃ</cite> (<he>נהירן</he>) <he>אפוי נהירין</he> his looks were bright.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 58b:11">Ber. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ לי שבילי וכ׳</he> the paths of the heavens (the courses of the heavenly bodies) are as clear (well-known) to me as the streets &c.; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:2:4">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>נ׳ את כד הוינן וכ׳</he> dost thou remember when we were standing &c.?; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:7:3">Y. Meg. III, 74ᵇ</cite> bot.

V, 30ᵃ</cite> top <he>נ׳ דהויתון וכ׳</he> (insert <cite ref="G00078"><he>את</he></cite>) dost thou remember that thou &c.? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 2:9:3">Y. Orl. II, 62ᶜ</cite> top [read:] <he>נ׳ את דאמריתון את וכ׳</he> dost thou remember that you, thyself and R. J., said &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 5:3:3">Y. Naz. V, end, 54ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ הוינין וכ׳</he> we remember that an old man was here &c.; Y. Ber. VIII, 11ᵇ bot. <he>נ׳ אנן</he>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:3">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>נהרין אנן</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:11">Koh. R. to VII, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 54a:5">Ḥull. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא נְהִירַת ליה וכ׳</he> dost thou not remember (recognize) that student &c.? <cite ref="Chullin 93a:3">Ib. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>נְהִירְנָא</he> I remember.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 91b">B. Bath. 91ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 34b:9">R. Hash. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>כי נהירנא לך</he>, v. <cite ref="N00516"><he>נְחַר</he></cite>].
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to give light, shine; to illumine, brighten, make shine.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 6:25">Targ. Num. VI, 25</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Yoma III, beg. 40ᵇ <he>א׳ מְנַהֲרָא</he>, v. <cite ref="B01314"><he>בְּרַק</he> I</cite>; Y. R. Hash. II, beg. 57ᵈ. Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ bot. <he>שמענן … והיא מְנַהֲרָה</he> we hear that when he entered the Temple court, it used to shine; <he>עאל ואַנְהָרַת</he> he entered, and it shone.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11:1">Cant. R. to V, 11</cite> <he>הוה מנהרא לי וכ׳</he> it (the Law) brightened my countenance by night.
<cite ref="Sotah 6a:10">Sot. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>וא׳ לן עיינין וכ׳</he> and he enlightened our eyes (by evidence) from our Mishnah; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to recall to memory, remember. Y. Peah III, 17ᵈ bot. וא׳ ר׳ אימי וכ׳ whereupon R. I. recalled (that he had heard the same tradition), and rescinded his decision. Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵃ bot. א׳ ונפיק וכ׳ it struck him (that he had forgotten to hear his grandson’s lesson), and he left the bath house &c.; a. e.—Part. pass. מְנַהַר; pl. מְנַהֲרִין.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:2">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>אתון … מְנַהֲרִין אנא מְנַהַר ליה</he> you do not remember that poor man, I will remember him.
